capabilities: Publish a note as a web page with a stable link
Update the same page by republishing after edits
Share a note privately with named email addresses
Publish a note together with its linked notes
Export a note as Word or PDF
extras: Requires a free TransformPipe account; published text is not end-to-end encrypted. Limits: images up to 1 MB each and 2 MB per note, notes up to 4 MB, last ten revisions kept, up to 50 linked notes per publish. Embedded notes (![[Another note]]) are not yet inlined. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Sharing a single note with people who don't use Obsidian means screenshots that crop tables, pasted Markdown that loses formatting, or PDFs that go stale after edits.
summary: Publishing plugin that turns a note into a web page on the TransformPipe service with a stable link, plus private sharing and Word/PDF export.
